The '''Cardooine system''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Jospro sector/Legends|Jospro sector]]. It contained the planet [[Cardooine/Legends|Cardooine]].

Cardooine was where the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] built [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] used in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. It was also the home of [[Fijisi]] wood, used in sections of the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and other high-class buildings.

The disease [[Cardooine Chills]] originated within this system.
